title: feat(desktop): keep the webcam file paired in the library and serve it to the editor (NIW2-572)
body:
PR 2 of the webcam-track stack ([design #437](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/437) → [#441 recorder](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/441) → this). Linear [NIW2-572](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-572), parent [NIW2-565](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-565). Base: `feature/niw2-571-webcam-recorder`.

## What this does

The library now treats the webcam file from #441 as part of the recording. A recording exposes `webcam` (offset, quality, size, recorded bubble layout) when the file exists. The new `kaipu-media://webcam/<id>` route serves that file to the editor. "Remove local copy" refuses while the file exists, because the cloud does not carry it yet.

## Why

The editor (#3–#5 of the stack) needs a way to find and play the webcam file. Without this PR, "Remove local copy" would delete the screen and leave the webcam file orphaned, with no cloud copy to restore it from.

## What changes for you

- **"Remove local copy" is refused for recordings with a webcam track.** A toast explains why ("…has a webcam track…", in English and neutral Spanish). The workaround is to delete the recording or keep it; the refusal lifts once cloud upload exists (plan 03).
- Recordings without a webcam: nothing changes.

## What to review

1. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/media-protocol.ts:100` and `:110`: the new hostname.** The unsafe-id guard runs on the decoded id before any hostname branch, and the path is always `.kaipu/<id>.webcam.mp4`. Decide whether you want an empty or malformed id to answer 400 or 404 (today: 400 for an unsafe id, 404 for a missing file).
2. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/library/remove-local-copy-policy.ts:27`: the refusal's order.** It comes after the cloud checks and the edit-session check, so a recording that also fails those shows their reason first.
3. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/library/library-vault.ts:170`: `describe().webcam` is `null` unless the file exists and the sidecar field passes `sanitizeWebcamTrackMeta`.** `probeWebcam` uses the same sanitizer. Note the one place they still disagree: a webcam file with no valid sidecar field is "present" for the refusal but `null` for `describe()` (follow-up V1). The refusal errs on the safe side.

**Safe to skim:** `shared/types/*` (the optional field), `library-detail-page.tsx` (a reason-to-toast map), the i18n pair (key parity checked by the reviewer), and `library-vault.mdx`.

## Proof

| Criterion (NIW2-572) | What was done | How to check it | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LocalRecording` exposes the webcam read from the sidecar | `describe()` fills `webcam` only when the file exists and the field is valid | `library-vault.test.ts` "describe exposes the sidecar's webcam when the file exists", "…no webcam when … the file is gone", "…without the field, even with a stray file" | Unit tests pass |
| `kaipu-media://webcam/<id>` serves the file with Range support | New hostname on the existing guard and `streamFile` | `media-protocol.test.ts`: 200, 206 + `content-range`, 404, 400 for `..` and `\` | Unit tests pass; **not run under real Electron** |
| Delete removes both files; rename keeps them paired | Delete came in #441. Rename only changes the title on this branch (rename-on-disk is the unmerged NIW2-560) | `library-vault.test.ts` "rename changes the title only and keeps the webcam file paired" | Unit tests pass. **Moving the file on rename: not done**, recorded on [NIW2-560](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-560) |
| "Remove local copy" is refused while a webcam file exists, with a reason string | Policy reason `webcam-track`, toast key `removeLocalCopyBlockedWebcam` | `remove-local-copy-policy.test.ts`, `library-service.test.ts` | Unit tests pass; the toast is **not seen on a real app** |
| Recordings without a webcam behave exactly as before | `webcam: null`, `probeWebcam` → `none`, the policy input is optional | Full suite | 312 files, 3040 tests passed |
| Unit tests for each; check-types, lint and tests pass | — | `vitest run`; pre-push `verify:local` | exit 0; pre-push passed |

## Decisions

- **The refusal keys on the file existing, not the sidecar field.** Options: the file, the sanitized field, or both. Taken: the file, as the spec says. Losing a file with no cloud copy is the failure that matters, and a stray file with a bad field still blocks (V1, declined).
- **`probeWebcam` is a separate function** from `probeEditing`, because `probeEditing` returns the existing `EditingState` strings and its type should not widen.
- **`probeWebcam` is not wired into `LibraryItem` or the editor IPC yet.** The editor's missing-file state belongs to the editor PRs.
- **Rename stays title-only here.** The move belongs in NIW2-560 (PR #435); a test there acts as a tripwire.

## Review ledger

> [!CAUTION]
> **Risk: high.** Touches `media-protocol.ts` (a URL id becomes a file path), shared library types (`library-storage.ts`, `library-item.ts`) and i18n messages.

| id | severity | outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V3 | nit | fixed: 220ba48a (`probeWebcam` uses `sanitizeWebcamTrackMeta`, plus a malformed-field test) |
| V5 | nit | fixed: 220ba48a (the vault doc table lists the webcam on `remove`) |
| V1 | nit | declined, follow-up: one predicate for "has a webcam track" in the probe and in `describe()` |
| V2 | nit | declined, follow-up: check the edit session and webcam before hashing in `removeLocalCopy` |
| V4 | nit | declined, recorded on NIW2-560: rename-on-disk must move the webcam file |

Rounds: 2 with Opus 5.5 (fresh-context reviewer) and 1 with Codex (cross-provider, read-only: APPROVE, no findings). Budget 5.
**Verdict for 220ba48a (patch-id 791bac9872ec): approved, only nits remain.**

## Checks

- `cd apps/kaipu-record && vitest run`: exit 0, 312 files, 3040 tests passed (on 220ba48a).
- Pre-push `verify:local` (lint, oxfmt, build, check-types): passed on push.

## Manual verification

This is owner QA; agents do not run Electron on the owner's machine. It needs a take recorded with #441.

**Setup:** `git checkout feature/niw2-572-webcam-vault && bun install && bun run dev`.

**1. Remove local copy is refused**
- Open a recording made with the camera on and choose "Remove local copy".
- Expect: a toast saying it has a webcam track; both files are still there.
- Broken if: the screen file is gone and the webcam file is left behind.

**2. The protocol route**
- In DevTools for the main window, run `await fetch('kaipu-media://webcam/<id>').then(r => [r.status, r.headers.get('content-type')])`.
- Expect: `200` and a video type. With `headers: { Range: 'bytes=0-9' }`, expect `206`.

**3. Delete**
- Delete the recording.
- Expect: `.kaipu/<id>.webcam.mp4` is gone.

**4. An old recording**
- Open one made before #441.
- Expect: nothing changes, and "Remove local copy" behaves as before.

## What I did not verify

- The route and the toast under real Electron.
- Rename-on-disk, which is not on this branch.
- Windows.
